user_does: Opens bublsolar.com and browses the menu.
good_result: Can easily find the product categories, search and cart. Nothing overlaps or blocks the buttons on mobile.

checks.expected: Can the shopper see the product categories (or the open menu), search and the cart, with nothing overlapping or blocking them?

good_result: Solaris appears in the results, and clicking it opens the correct product page.

checks.expected: Is Solaris listed as a product in the search results (with its name and price), not only mentioned in passing?

good_result: Shows at least one suitable lamp, such as Solaris, rather than no results or unrelated products.
Sees relevant products such as Walkie, Walkie X and Comfort, with working images, prices and product links.

checks.expected: Does each listed product (such as Walkie, Walkie X and Comfort) show its own price on the page?

user_does: Opens Solaris to understand whether it suits their needs.
good_result: Can easily find its dimensions, brightness, charging options, charging time, battery runtime and warranty. Information is consistent across the page.

checks.expected: Does the page say how Solaris can be charged (for example USB-C and solar)?
Are the numbers consistent across the page (no conflicting runtime, charging time or brightness figures)?

user_does: Changes the Solaris colour from Black to Sand or Rust Red.
good_result: The selected colour is clear, the main image matches it, and any price or availability change is shown before adding it.

checks.expected: Does the page show the price and whether each colour (Black, Sand, Rust Red) can be bought, before adding to cart?
After choosing Sand, is Sand clearly marked as the selected colour, does the main photo show a Sand-coloured lamp, and is the price shown?

user_does: Uses the "Turn On" preview and browses product photos.
good_result: The preview shows the lamp illuminated, photos load correctly, and the customer can close the enlarged view easily.

checks.expected: After pressing Turn On, does the photo show the lamp lit up (glowing), with a way to turn it off again?

user_does: Starts with an empty cart, selects one Solaris and clicks "Add to cart" once.
good_result: Exactly one lamp in the selected colour is added. The cart does not unexpectedly contain five lamps or extra products.

checks.expected: After one click on Add to cart, does the cart show exactly one Solaris lamp, in Black, and nothing else?

user_does: Adds one Solaris and one Walkie, then refreshes the page.
good_result: Both products remain in the cart with the correct options and quantities, without duplicates or missing items.

checks.expected: Does the cart list one Solaris and one Walkie, each with quantity 1 and its colour or option, and no duplicates?

user_does: Checks the final order summary before payment.
good_result: Products, colours, quantities and discounts match the cart. Shipping charges and the final payable amount are clearly shown, with no unexplained extras. Any free-shipping promise is honoured.

checks.expected: Does the cart show the product, its colour, the quantity and a total price, with no unexplained extra items or charges?
On the checkout page, do the products, colours, quantities, discounts, shipping and final amount match the cart, with any free-shipping promise honoured?
